description: This file defines the CallFormBase class, which extends FormBase and provides methods for generating HTML forms for creating and editing 'Call' records within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for constructing form headers, bodies, and footers, as well as handling form submissions and saving data, with access control and relationship management functionalities.

classes.name: CallFormBase
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate and handle HTML forms for 'Call' records in SuiteCRM, including form rendering and save handling functionalities.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML form body for creating or editing a Call record, including fields for subject, date, time, and appointment type.

methods.name: getFormHeader
methods.description: Returns the HTML form header for a Call form, with optional custom title.

methods.name: getFormFooter
methods.description: Returns the HTML form footer, including submit button and footer elements.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Assembles and returns the complete HTML form for creating or editing a Call record.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the submitted form data, performs validation, manages relationships and saves the Call bean, with support for AJAX responses and redirection.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates an expanded version of the form body, suitable for wide display, with additional appointment description input.
